title: A Biochip for Rapid Diagnosis of Complicated Urinary Tract Infection
brief_summary: The purpose of this proposal is clinical validation of an electrochemical biochip for rapid pathogen identification and antibiotic susceptibility determination.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients suspected or at risk for complicated urinary tract infections

Exclusion Criteria:

* Gross contamination of urine samples at the time of collection
study_population: Patients at risk for urinary tract infections.
